course.title: Carpentry & Woodworking Basics
course.description: A beginner-oriented video learning collection for carpentry and woodworking. The five lessons are curated from supplied YouTube links; specific lesson titles, descriptions, and outcomes should be verified against each video before publishing.
learningOutcomes: Become familiar with carpentry and woodworking topics presented in the selected videos.
Recognize common woodworking tools and materials as covered by the lessons.
Develop awareness of measuring, shaping, joining, and finishing concepts where demonstrated.
Understand the importance of workshop safety and appropriate supervision.
